## Marker Vocabulary

windup_start; hit; projectile_spawn; cast; vfx_spawn; recover_start; recover_end

## Marker Format


| Field | Contract / value |
| --- | --- |
| name | one of marker_vocabulary |
| phase | normalized time [0,1] within visual clip |
| event id | provided at playback by resolver event; never authored damage |
| order | windup_start <= hit/cast <= recover_start <= recover_end; projectile_spawn/vfx_spawn may be at their authored visual phases |


## Authority

Combat resolver event ID and timestamp are authoritative. Clips/markers never calculate, apply, roll, repeat or undo damage. A marker only requests visual/audio presentation.

## Synchronization


| Field | Contract / value |
| --- | --- |
| attack | Fit anticipation/contact/recovery to event timeline without changing event time. If too short, shorten/reduce presentation or use fallback impact; do not delay damage. |
| projectile | Travel VFX to authoritative impact time; no physics collision authority. |
| interrupt | KO cancels outgoing presentation and pending cosmetic markers; already-resolved damage is never rolled back. |
| seek replay | Reconstruct state at target time; suppress historical one-shot sounds/VFX. Deduplicate by event ID and cue kind. |
| dodge | Show only on authoritative dodge event; clip motion never changes dodge probability. |
| reflected damage | Reaction follows reflected event, no recursive attack animation generated. |
| missing clip | Log contract error and use neutral/reaction fallback; do not block simulation. |


## Locomotion

Optional later walk/run clips use the same contract; not required while combat remains non-spatial. No jump, flight, taunt or ultimate added without shared need.

## Export

Separate named actions, baked at 30 fps; no strip suffix, automatic .001 names or exporter loop-name suffix. Loop flags live in this contract/import adapter.

## Verification

v1.18 validates specification names and marker schemas only. First GLB must prove actual clip presence/loops/rest/root-motion and runtime event synchronization in v1.19.
